exposure: caesarean section performed in the second stage of labor
outcome: intraoperative complications (blood transfusion, uterine incision extension)
postoperative complications (prolonged catheterization, abdominal distension, febrile illness)
cohort: The study participants were term pregnancies (>37 weeks) who underwent caesarean section, with a focus on those performed in the second stage of labor, at Assam Medical College.
finding: The study found that complications are common in second-stage caesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study found that second-stage caesarean sections are associated with common intraoperative and postoperative complications.
